caption: King of the Lions Cake
alt: A realistic lion head cake with a sculpted, textured mane in shades of golden brown and cream, featuring detailed painted facial features including amber eyes, a pink nose, and black whiskers, set against a black background.

caption: Lion Cake
alt: A realistic painting of a male lion's head with a golden mane and white beard, set against a green background and signed by the artist in the bottom right corner.

caption: Staple Center
alt: A detailed cake sculpture features a replica of the Staples Center arena perched atop a basketball, accompanied by a Lakers jersey with the number 24 and a sneaker, all set on a court-themed base.

caption: Beer and Snacks Grooms Cake
alt: A novelty cake designed to look like a wooden crate overflowing with a bag of Wise potato chips and Kit Kat bars, with five fondant Heineken beer cans stacked in a pyramid formation and topped with popcorn.

caption: Jackalope Cake
alt: A multi-tiered camouflage-patterned cake features a sculpted brown bunny wearing antlers and a camo vest, with the name "Aaron" written in gold icing on the chocolate base.

caption: Beagle Chasing Hare Cake
alt: A diorama depicts a tricolor hound wearing a black vest with the number 13 in pursuit of a brown hare through an autumnal forest floor scattered with orange leaves and bare trees.

caption: Computer Geek and Alien Cake
alt: A blue birthday cake decorated with fondant figures of a yellow bicycle helmet, a green alien head, a tablet displaying "Happy Birthday Ian," a smartphone, a blue car, USB drives, and a computer mouse.

caption: BBQ Cake
alt: A square cake decorated to resemble a picnic scene features a realistic hamburger, an ear of corn, a watermelon slice, and a dessert on a blue and white checkered blanket atop green grass.

caption: Hang Glider Stuck in Tree Cake
alt: A detailed clay diorama depicts a man in a red helmet and yellow shirt suspended in a striped hang glider between two trees, hovering over a dense canopy of green and yellow leaves.

caption: Gym Cake
alt: A gym-themed cake features a large fondant weight plate labeled "Jake's Gym" with a bodybuilder illustration, alongside a sculpted dumbbell, a Power Bar, and a white towel, all resting on a blue rectangular base.

caption: Sail Boat Cake
alt: A white model sailboat with two masts sits atop a sculpted blue and white resin base designed to resemble ocean waves.

caption: Bear Cake
alt: A realistic cake sculpted to resemble a brown bear's head rests behind a detailed cake replica of a knife with a red handle and sheath, all displayed on a black marble-patterned surface.
A detailed cake sculpted to look like a yellow and white fire engine labeled "Monticello Engine 49," complete with fondant hoses and a cone, set against a dramatic backdrop of a raging wildfire.
